ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Scope of Minnesota's Somali Aid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud and misuse of funds intended for Somali aid in Minnesota, including the $4M daycare with no kids and misspelled sign
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to determine the extent of the fraud and identify those responsible
questions: Who benefited from the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. I will investigate further to determine the scope and impact of the alleged fraud.
